name: The Champions Circuit
license: Pokemon names are trademarks of Nintendo/Creatures/Game Freak/The Pokemon Company.
backdrop: The Champions Circuit is a season of official VGC doubles events. Each event is held in a host city: a convention venue with a registration desk and a stage, a hotel where players stay, and practice halls and cafes where they test teams and talk shop. Players bring a team of six at level 50 and pick four for each match. Locals are small events in a game shop or community hall; Regionals fill a convention centre; Internationals draw players from every continent; Worlds is the one invitational at the end of the season. Championship Points from good placings open the bigger events, and enough of them earn the Worlds invite.
